import React from "react";

interface IconProps {
  className?: string;
  size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl";
}

const sizeClasses = {
  sm: "w-4 h-4",
  md: "w-5 h-5",
  lg: "w-6 h-6",
  xl: "w-8 h-8",
};

// Enhanced Dashboard Icon - сучасний дизайн з градієнтами
export const DashboardIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2.5}
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="dashboardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="1" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.7" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect
      x="3"
      y="3"
      width="7"
      height="7"
      rx="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#dashboardGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    <rect
      x="14"
      y="3"
      width="7"
      height="7"
      rx="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#dashboardGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    <rect
      x="14"
      y="14"
      width="7"
      height="7"
      rx="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#dashboardGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    <rect
      x="3"
      y="14"
      width="7"
      height="7"
      rx="2"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#dashboardGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    {/* Add subtle inner details */}
    <circle cx="6.5" cy="6.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.6" />
    <circle cx="17.5" cy="6.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.6" />
    <circle cx="17.5" cy="17.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.6" />
    <circle cx="6.5" cy="17.5" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.6" />
  </svg>
);

// Enhanced Users/Clients Icon - сучасна іконка з множинними користувачами
export const UsersIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2.5}
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="usersGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="1" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.7" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    {/* Main user */}
    <path
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"
      fill="url(#usersGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    <circle 
      cx="9" 
      cy="7" 
      r="4" 
      strokeLinecap="round" 
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#usersGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.15"
    />
    {/* Second user (overlapping) */}
    <path
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"
      opacity="0.8"
    />
    <circle 
      cx="16" 
      cy="7" 
      r="3" 
      strokeLinecap="round" 
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      opacity="0.8"
      fill="url(#usersGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    {/* Connection indicator */}
    <circle cx="20" cy="4" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.6" />
  </svg>
);

// Enhanced Tasks Icon - сучасна іконка з детальним списком завдань
export const TasksIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2.5}
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="tasksGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="1" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.7" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    <rect
      x="3"
      y="4"
      width="18"
      height="16"
      rx="3"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#tasksGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    {/* Header */}
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M3 9h18" opacity="0.7" />
    {/* Checkmark */}
    <path 
      strokeLinecap="round" 
      strokeLinejoin="round" 
      d="m8 13 2 2 4-4" 
      strokeWidth="3"
      fill="url(#tasksGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.2"
    />
    {/* Task lines */}
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M7 16h6" opacity="0.6" />
    <circle cx="17" cy="13" r="1.5" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.5" />
    <circle cx="17" cy="16" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.3" />
  </svg>
);

// Enhanced Metrics/Charts Icon - сучасна іконка з детальною аналітикою
export const MetricsIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2.5}
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="metricsGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="1" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.7" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    {/* Chart background */}
    <rect
      x="2"
      y="2"
      width="20"
      height="20"
      rx="3"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      fill="url(#metricsGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.05"
    />
    {/* Axes */}
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 19V5" opacity="0.7" />
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 19h14" opacity="0.7" />
    {/* Chart line with gradient */}
    <path 
      strokeLinecap="round" 
      strokeLinejoin="round" 
      d="m7 14 3-3 3 2 4-4" 
      strokeWidth="3"
      stroke="url(#metricsGradient)"
    />
    {/* Data points */}
    <circle cx="7" cy="14" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.8" />
    <circle cx="10" cy="11" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.8" />
    <circle cx="13" cy="13" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.8" />
    <circle cx="17" cy="9" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.8" />
    {/* Trend indicator */}
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M15 7l2 2-2 2" strokeWidth="2" opacity="0.6" />
  </svg>
);

// Enhanced Settings Icon - сучасна іконка налаштувань з шестернею
export const SettingsIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2.5}
  >
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="settingsGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="1" />
        <stop offset="100%" stopColor="currentColor" stopOpacity="0.7" />
      </linearGradient>
    </defs>
    {/* Main gear */}
    <path
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      d="M12 15a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6Z"
      fill="url(#settingsGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.15"
    />
    <path
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83 2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 0 1-2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 0 1-2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 0 1-2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2-2h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 0-2.83 2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 0 1 2-2 2 2 0 0 1 2 2v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 0 1 2.83 0 2 2 0 0 1 0 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 0 1 2 2 2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1Z"
      fill="url(#settingsGradient)"
      fillOpacity="0.1"
    />
    {/* Center highlight */}
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.3" />
    {/* Small gear indicators */}
    <circle cx="18" cy="6" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.5" />
    <circle cx="6" cy="18" r="1" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.5" />
  </svg>
);

// Bot Icon - більш сучасна іконка робота
export const BotIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",
  size = "lg",
}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    strokeWidth={2}
  >
    <path
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      d="M12 2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2c0 .74-.4 1.39-1 1.73V7h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v9a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7a2 2 0 0 1-2-2V9a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h4V5.73c-.6-.34-1-.99-1-1.73a2 2 0 0 1 2-2Z"
    />
    <circle cx="9" cy="12" r="1" />
    <circle cx="15" cy="12" r="1" />
    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 16h6" />
  </svg>
);

// Worker Icon - іконка працівника/інструментів
export const WorkerIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
  className = "",

}) => (
  <svg
    className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${className}`}

export const StreamHubIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({
